claims.text:
latent-diffusion

**Identity / target / source:** `ai:latent-diffusion` → `ai-latent-diffusion` → `src/demos/ai/ai-latent-diffusion`; source `company/domains/proposals/2026-10-18-ai-map-expansion.json#concepts/83`; brief `company/domains/briefs/2026-10-19-ai-next30e.md#6-latent-diffusion`. **Packet:** G2. **Level / prerequisites:** stretch; `ai:diffusion-denoising`, `ai:autoencoder-bottleneck`.

**Nearest / distinct payoff:** autoencoder-bottleneck isolates compression loss; this actually corrupts and denoises a smaller code before decoding, with explicit state-count limits.

**Computed primary model:** EncoderE averages adjacent pairs of a4-vector; decoderD repeats each code coordinate. Signalx=[1,1,−1,−1] encodesz=[1,−1]. Add declared latent noise[.5,−.5]→[1.5,−1.5]. Fixed denoiser shrinks latent by.5→[.75,−.75], decoding[.75,.75,−.75,−.75]. Squared error.25 versus1 for decoding the noisy code. Evolving state dimension2 versus4; encoder/decoder and other runtime costs excluded.

**Countercase / boundary:** Off-family signal[1,−1,1,−1] encodes[0,0]; even noiseless perfect latent recovery decodeszero with error4. Compression can discard information before denoising. Shrinkage is supplied, not a trained image denoiser, and the dimension ratio is not measured speedup.

**Prediction / transfer recall:** Predict whether halving latent error guarantees zero decoded error; recall irrecoverable antisymmetric pair differences remain absent even with no noise.

**Intervention / retained witness:** Encode/Add noise/Denoise/Decode exposes all states and errors, then Off family shows compression loss with retained primary noisy/denoised outputs. Required distinction: code dimension versus end-to-end compute.

**Source obligation:** [Rombach et al. original abstract](https://arxiv.org/abs/2112.10752), opened2026-10-19 as latent-space diffusion motivation. Full method-body acquisition remains before any architecture/empirical attribution; this fixed linear codec and shrinkage are not the paper model.
